title: A kiwellin protein-like fold containing rust effector protein localizes to chloroplast and suppress cell death in plants
authors: Jaswal R; Rajarammohan S; Dubey H; Kiran K; Rawal H; Sonah H; Deshmukh R; Sharma TR
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过计算结构预测和实验表征锈菌效应蛋白的kiwellin折叠及N端无序区域在叶绿体定位和抑制细胞死亡中的作用，虽涉及IDR和蛋白功能，但未聚焦PPI互作机制建模，且方法以同源建模和实验为主，AI/物理模拟贡献有限。
abstract:
The effector proteins expressed by plant pathogens are one of the essential components of the host-pathogen interaction. Despite being important, most of the effector proteins remain unexplored due to the lack of conserved features and huge diversity in their primary sequence. In the present study, extensive secretome analysis was performed in sixteen major plant fungal pathogens to find the conserved features in the candidate secretory effector proteins (CSEPs) using homology and ab initio modeling approaches. Interestingly, a variable number of plant kiwellin proteins fold like secretory proteins were found in all the major rust fungal pathogens. Many of them are predicted as potential effector proteins. For instance, 26 out of 35 Kiwellin like proteins identified in Puccinia striiformis race 104E 137A were predicted as potential effector proteins. In addition, a kiwellin predicted effector gene, Pst_13960 , from the Indian Puccinia striiformis race Yr9 was characterized using overexpression, localization, and deletion studies in Nicotiana benthamiana . The Pst_13960 suppressed the BAX-induced cell death and localized in the chloroplast. Furthermore, the expression of the kiwellin matching region ( Pst_13960_kiwi ) alone suppressed the BAX-induced cell death in N. benthamiana despite the change of location to the cytoplasm and nucleus, suggesting the novel function of the kiwellin fold in rust fungi. Further analysis of these proteins predicted these candidates to contain N-terminal Intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) putatively associated with chloroplast translocation as deletion of region abolished the chloroplast localization of Pstr_13960 . Overall, the current study reports the presence of kiwellin like proteins in rust fungi that act as a novel effector in plants.

Author Summary

Rust fungi are one of the most devastating plants infecting pathogens. These pathogens secrete several distinct proteins like effector proteins that help the pathogens in the establishment of infection by suppressing cell death induced by the plants. Despite being important, these effector proteins remain unexplored due to the lack of conserved features. Currently, different methods are being used to characterize them however, could not describe their specific function fully due to a lack of knowledge of the functional domain. Recent advancement in effector protein tertiary structure characterization using NMR (Nuclear magnetic resonance) and X-ray crystallography has been very helpful in identifying the conserved structural features defining functionality. However, these techniques are quite complicated and may take a lot of time and labor. On the other hand, the computational approaches for structural prediction of the effectors may help to identify known folds or domains with few efforts but at a significant level. Therefore, such computational approaches can be efficiently implemented in the preliminary screening of the candidates. In the present study using the computational structure prediction method, we were able to find several conserved novel kiwellin folds containing effectors, in different rust fungi. We characterized one of the candidates and it showed interference with artificially induced cell death in plants. This study highlights the novel function of the kiwellin like effector proteins of the rust fungi that are already identified to play a role in host defense against plant pathogens.
abstract_zh:
植物病原体表达的效应蛋白是宿主-病原体相互作用的关键组成部分之一。尽管重要，但由于缺乏保守特征且初级序列高度多样，大多数效应蛋白仍未得到充分研究。本研究对十六种主要植物真菌病原体进行了广泛的分泌组分析，利用同源建模和从头建模方法寻找候选分泌效应蛋白（CSEPs）中的保守特征。有趣的是，在所有主要锈菌病原体中均发现了数量可变的植物kiwellin蛋白，其折叠方式类似分泌蛋白，其中许多被预测为潜在效应蛋白。例如，在条锈菌（Puccinia striiformis）小种104E 137A中鉴定出的35个Kiwellin样蛋白中，有26个被预测为潜在效应蛋白。此外，来自印度条锈菌小种Yr9的一个预测效应基因Pst_13960，通过在本氏烟（Nicotiana benthamiana）中的过表达、定位和缺失研究进行了表征。Pst_13960抑制了BAX诱导的细胞死亡，并定位于叶绿体。进一步地，仅表达kiwellin匹配区域（Pst_13960_kiwi）也能抑制本氏烟中BAX诱导的细胞死亡，尽管其定位改变至细胞质和细胞核，这表明kiwellin折叠在锈菌中具有新功能。对这些蛋白的进一步分析预测，这些候选蛋白含有N端固有无序区域（IDRs），可能与叶绿体转位相关，因为该区域的缺失消除了Pstr_13960的叶绿体定位。总体而言，本研究报道了锈菌中存在kiwellin样蛋白，这些蛋白在植物中作为新型效应子发挥作用。

作者总结

锈菌是感染植物最具破坏性的病原体之一。这些病原体分泌多种不同蛋白，如效应蛋白，通过抑制植物诱导的细胞死亡来帮助病原体建立感染。尽管重要，但由于缺乏保守特征，这些效应蛋白仍未得到充分研究。目前，已有多种方法用于表征它们，但由于对功能域了解不足，无法完全描述其特定功能。近年来，利用核磁共振（NMR）和X射线晶体学对效应蛋白三级结构表征的进展，在识别定义功能性的保守结构特征方面非常有用。然而，这些技术相当复杂，可能耗时费力。另一方面，用于效应子结构预测的计算方法可能以较少努力但显著水平帮助识别已知折叠或域。因此，此类计算方法可有效应用于候选物的初步筛选。在本研究中，利用计算结构预测方法，我们能够在不同锈菌中发现多个含有保守新型kiwellin折叠的效应子。我们表征了其中一个候选物，并显示其干扰植物中人工诱导的细胞死亡。本研究强调了锈菌kiwellin样效应蛋白的新功能，这些蛋白已被确定在宿主防御植物病原体中发挥作用。
